newsitem.title: USA: Black & Decker Q1 hurt by dlr, taxes.
newsitem.headline: Black & Decker Q1 hurt by dlr, taxes.

text.p: Black & Decker Corp said on Friday that its first-quarter financial results were hurt by foreign currency translation, a higher tax rate and lower sales of its SnakeLight flexible flashlight.
Black & Decker reported first quarter net operating income of $0.27 per share, compared to $0.35 for the same period the year before.
The company said it is preparing to launch higher-margin new products, and expects accelerated sales growth and improved operating margins in the second half of the year.

Black & Decker also sees incremental benefits of as much as $40 million during 1997 from its restructuring program, which focuses on improving the performance of consumer businesses, particularly in Europe.
